keystore.error:
SIGNING_KEY is not set, so there is no keystore to sign with.
  It must be a repository secret holding the base64 of a keystore, e.g.
    .github/scripts/new-signing-key.sh          # prints it, and a fingerprint
    gh secret set SIGNING_KEY --repo <owner>/<repo> < signingkey.b64
  The build refuses to run without it: upstream falls back to the debug key
  when signingkey.jks is missing, which would publish extensions signed with
  a key nobody controls and that nobody could update later.
